purpose: Freeze a small behaviorally distinct set of shadow-buy rules after burned A+B development simulation, before future prospective outcome evaluation. These are research candidates only; not real-money instructions.

probability_source.rule: All ticket probabilities must be derived from one coherent ordered-top3 probability object. S0 and challenger are both retained for comparison.

development_disclosure.consequence: Any rule selected because it looked favorable in A+B is development-derived and requires new prospective replication. A+B profitability cannot validate it.

conditions: S0 and challenger must agree on the top1 rider
min(S0 top1 probability, challenger top1 probability) >= 0.40
shadow_candidates.ticket: One unordered 3renhuku ticket using the common top1 plus the next two riders under the frozen ranking rule.
shadow_candidates.interpretation: Near-break-even combined burned development benchmark but unstable by segment; not a profit rule.

conditions: Timestamp-proven PRE decimal odds for the exact ticket must be available before the declared decision cutoff
shadow_candidates.probability_for_EV: Use the conservative minimum of the frozen S0-derived and challenger-derived ticket probabilities for selection.

burned_AB_context.note: Grid-discovered on burned A+B; therefore especially requires prospective replication.

shadow_candidates.interpretation: Promising development signal only. The favorable A+B result is selection-biased by the search process and is not a validated edge.

conditions: S0 and challenger must agree on top1
min(S0 top1 probability, challenger top1 probability) >= 0.40
shadow_candidates.tickets: Three wide tickets pairing the common top1 with the next three riders.
shadow_candidates.shadow_stake: 100 yen per elementary ticket, 300 yen total per selected race
shadow_candidates.interpretation: Deliberately retained as a high-hit-rate control showing that frequent hits do not imply positive economics.

staking_freeze.reason: Burned A+B showed stake sizing magnifies drawdown and cannot rescue negative edge. Edge quality is tested before bankroll optimization.

anti_hindsight: Do not change candidate definitions after seeing a prospective race result.
Do not reconstruct missing PRE odds from payout/result pages.
Do not add winning tickets or drop losing tickets after settlement.
Do not change stake size based on prospective outcomes.
Do not use current Segment C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 to choose or rescue candidates.
